title: The Pass Is Closed
hook: Ninety minutes of mountain you can't have yet.
scene: Spokane is two hundred and eighty miles east, and the only road that gets there climbs a pass you can't take on a permit, can't take alone, and can't take until you're better than you are right now. Gracie's on the passenger seat with her paws tucked. Mya's beside her, taking up more room than she needs to. They came because they always come. So today you do the small version: you go get the license, and then you start being someone who can drive the pass.

source.teaching_target: State the goal in miles. The pass is closed. Both cats are with her. Today is the license.
